description: TLS configured the way the fix recommends: Node `minVersion: "TLSv1.2"` with SSL_OP_NO_SSLv3 / SSL_OP_NO_TLSv1 / SSL_OP_NO_TLSv1_1 hardening flags (which DISABLE the old protocols), Python `ssl.TLSVersion.TLSv1_2`, the older `ssl.PROTOCOL_TLSv1_2` constant (TLS 1.2, not TLS 1.0) and `ssl.PROTOCOL_SSLv23` (the old name for PROTOCOL_TLS, negotiate-highest) with OP_NO_* flags turning off everything below TLS 1.2, Go `tls.VersionTLS12`, and a Go switch that only names the negotiated version for logging. Naming a deprecated protocol in order to switch it off, or to label it, is not configuring it. VC122 must not fire.
